text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered: latency_slo_burn (p95/p99) for model-serving-prod-us-west. Current burn window: 12m.
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident created and escalated: PD-3819 -> page sent to @devin.p (on-call)
devin.p: Acked. Looking now. Any recent deploys?
alex.k: Not that I'm aware of. No mainline deploys in last 30m. Quick checks: autoscaler logs + GPU memory pressure.
maria.c: Observed traffic spike from customer X (traffic spike ~3x last 10m). Also kvcache hit rate dropped.
samira.o: :eyes: grabbing metrics, dumping short window
samira.o: ```
window: last 15m
p95: 210ms (SLO 150ms)
p99: 1.2s (SLO 500ms)
qps: baseline 600 -> 1800
kvcache_hit: 6% (norm 42%)
sidecar_cpu: 92%
gpu_mem_util: 88%
```
devin.p: Interesting — kvcache hit drop suggests prefix variance or caching eviction. Could be new prompt pattern.
alex.k: Autoscaler shows low scale-up events for the tenant due to quota throttle: "scale_api: rate_limited" in logs. ops-bot: flagged quota limit on dedicated pool.
maria.c: So autoscaler didn't spin up more replicas -> tail latency spike. We can either (1) route high-volume tenant->dedicated pool (if capacity) or (2) reduce batching to lower per-request latency.
devin.p: Can we lower `max_batch_size` for prod-model-route `generate-v2` to 4 from 16 as a hotfix? That drops throughput but reduces tail latency.
samira.o: If we reduce batch size, CPU load will rise but p99 should drop quickly. We should also raise kv-cache TTL back to normal if it's being evicted.
alex.k: I can patch route config. Doing `redwoodctl routes update --route generate-v2 --max-batch-size 4 --kvcache-ttl 300` now.
ops-bot: rolling config update to 12/24 replicas in us-west. Patch CID: cfg-8792
samira.o: patch applied. Observability: tail latency re-polling.
samira.o: ```
2m after patch
p95: 170ms
p99: 580ms
kvcache_hit: 18%
sidecar_cpu: 95%
```
maria.c: p99 still slightly above SLO but much improved. Need sustained improvement.
devin.p: Can we temporarily route ~30% of traffic to eu-west where dedicated pool has spare capacity? That buys us time while we coordinate with infra for quota raise.
alex.k: eu-west has slack capacity but cross-region routing will add latency for EU-US traffic; however for this tenant it’s acceptable per their SLA.
alex.k: Implementing weighted routing: tenant X -> 70% us-west, 30% eu-west
ops-bot: route update applied (route-shift-123)
samira.o: metrics: ```
5m after routing
p95: 160ms
p99: 420ms
qps(us-west): 1200 -> down
qps(eu-west): +350
kvcache_hit: 26%
```
devin.p: Nice. p99 back under 500ms SLO, but keep watching for oscillations.
maria.c: Noted customer notified? They were generating a lot of requests; ops should ping them to throttle if needed.
alex.k: Sent DM to account team + posted message to #customer-success: "We see elevated traffic from your app causing higher latencies; we routed some traffic to eu-west and applied temporary configuration changes. Please throttle/patch if possible."
pagerduty: PD-3819 acknowledged by devin.p at 4012345680
devin.p: Moving to mitigation->followup. Actions: (1) request quota raise for us-west dedicated pool; (2) investigate root cause for kvcache eviction pattern; (3) add automated circuit breaker on tenant-level qps surge.
samira.o: I'll take kvcache investigation. Logs show frequent cache key churn matching new prompt templates from tenant.
maria.c: I'll own quota/infra coord with infra-ops. Reaching out now.
alex.k: I'll file a runbook PR to add tenant surge throttle + autoscaler retry/backoff improvements.
devin.p: Handing off to followup rotation. Handoff to next oncall @maria.c — I'll leave a summary in the incident ticket.
incident-bot: Incident PD-3819 transitioned to Postmortem queue; severity: Sev2; start: 4012345678; mitigated: 4012345698
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident resolved (ack cleared) by devin.p at 4012345710
maria.c: Leaving notes: increase kv-cache default TTL for heavy-prefix tenants, implement tenant-level qps guardrails, infra to remove autoscaler quota throttle.
samira.o: Will attach sample request patterns & cache key frag report to the ticket.
devin.p: Thanks all. If p99 climbs again, re-open PD immediately. Closing thread here and will update postmortem draft in #incidents.
alex.k: :thumbsup: Logged runbook items and follow-ups.
ops-bot: scheduled follow-up meeting with infra for quota removal — 2026-04-10 16:00 UTC
maria.c: Handoff complete.
